findingResolution.evidence: Final pre-DPAPI guard rehashes child, plan, metadata and final review. Full source/public inventories, plan, final review, manifest and adapter have verified read holds before preflight and through ordinary child exit; error cleanup terminates/waits before disposing holds.

The exact a2-to-a3 candidate delta is two early verified holds: final review before review parsing, then plan before hashing/parsing/inventory/window derivation. The approved file cannot be replaced after acquiring those holds. Wrong bytes fail the held hash check before parsing.

verifiedScope: Pure builder reproduces the exact frozen candidate and rejects changed predecessor.
Exact candidate parses with zero errors; historical ACL and UTC functions remain unchanged.
Source-only validation performs the complete pinned public preflight and exits before any private metadata/DPAPI access.
All 16 future public bindings and complete source inventory are held by hash before public preflight, with explicit plan/review/manifest/self and child holds.
Window is derived from the pinned held plan and serialized unchanged; no new expiry is computed by the adapter.
Bound child receives only the fixed execute mode and review hash through command-line parsing; private JSON uses the existing stdin path.
Existing error/public output blocks remain preserved and the bound A7 child exposes explicit public success/failure summaries.
